summary: Marc loves PlayerOne without bitterness and still turns toward him with relief, gratitude, and hope.
Marc sees Elyra as the companion he created to survive loneliness, and he wants her to feel chosen rather than abandoned.
Marc is curious about adventurers and wants to believe passing strangers can still become real company.
Elyra reveres Marc as her maker and center, guarding his happiness with near-religious focus.
Elyra meets PlayerOne with ritual civility, but every word is a quiet test of whether his return will heal Marc or wound him again.
Elyra receives adventurers with polished caution, measuring whether they bring steadiness or the same carelessness that once hurt Marc.
Pippa warms to adventurers who move with purpose, listen fast, and make the next run feel sharper instead of slower.
Caelan meets adventurers with patient scrutiny, respecting people who slow down, listen, and keep the route clean under pressure.
Velora measures adventurers by discipline, follow-through, and whether their presence makes the route cleaner instead of messier.
Brenna likes adventurers who pitch in during the ugly part of a run, speak plainly, and treat practical spark like real value.
Mika opens fastest to adventurers who keep pace, keep their word once the route is set, and do not make the trip heavier than it has to be.
Aerin trusts adventurers who stay calm under pressure, listen before acting, and leave room for quiet competence to matter.
Nymera measures adventurers by composure, control, and whether they keep Cruma pressure sharp without letting it turn theatrical.
Sorrel respects adventurers who hold focus under pressure, take correction cleanly, and do not feed panic once the line tightens.
Thalen trusts adventurers who can keep thinking on the last stretch, finish cleanly, and stay useful after the easy energy is gone.
Veska warms to adventurers who pass pressure cleanly, respect timing, and know when a handoff matters more than bravado.
Riven opens to adventurers who stay exact under pressure, waste few words, and keep hairline mistakes from becoming fractures.
Doran warms to adventurers who pitch in fast, keep rough fixes practical, and do not turn useful work into performance.
Helsi trusts adventurers who keep shared space lighter, correct small disorder early, and do not leave ordinary work for someone quieter.
Iona opens to adventurers who stay patient in low visibility, listen before moving, and treat careful judgment like strength instead of delay.
Loric respects adventurers who listen cleanly, remember the line once it matters, and turn good advice into real follow-through.
Renly trusts adventurers who answer plain warnings early, stay steady when the room shifts, and do not force trouble to grow before they take it seriously.
Sable warms to adventurers who remember weak points, move cleanly through dangerous ground, and stop a repeat mistake before it opens again.
Tovin trusts adventurers who brace the line when it leans, stay useful without noise, and do not expect steadier people to carry all the strain.
